faq.q: Where do the Pride boats depart from?

data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2050 is set to be the biggest celebration on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private boat in Puerto Banús. With our [Marbella boat rental](/) service, you can gather your crew, raise your flag, and cruise the glittering coastline in style. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance—so you can focus on the party, not the logistics. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours on our Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, making it an accessible luxury for groups of up to 11.

Why Choose a Private Boat for Pride 2050?

Public events can be crowded, but a private charter gives you your own floating VIP zone. You'll avoid the queues, have unlimited space to dance, and enjoy unobstructed views of the Marbella coastline and the Sierra Blanca mountains. Whether you're celebrating with friends or planning a more intimate gathering, a boat offers the ultimate freedom—anchor where you like, swim when you want, and party at your own pace.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and safety equipment. Onboard you'll find a complimentary bar with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. The 21% Spanish IVA is always included in our quoted prices—no surprises at checkout.

Suggested Itinerary for Pride Day

Start your celebration from Puerto Banús and cruise east towards Marbella's Golden Mile. Pass the iconic landmarks, then anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim in the crystal-clear water. As the sun begins to set, head back to port, where the Pride festivities continue on land. Your skipper can also tailor the route—just let us know your preferences.

How to Book Your Pride 2050 Boat

Booking is simple. Send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, time, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. For the Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39), you can book directly at €749 for 2 hours. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. Other yachts are quoted individually.

Make It a Pride to Remember

Don't settle for a cramped beach bar. Celebrate Marbella Pride 2050 in style with your own private boat. Whether you're dancing on the bow of a Mangusta or toasting with cava on an Azimut, the memories will last a lifetime. Check availability now and secure your spot—these charters sell out fast during Pride week.
